result.summary: In 2026 Zuckerberg mostly spoke about personal agents and 'personal superintelligence'. The clearest dated forecast is from the 29 July Q2 earnings call: billions of people will have a personal AI agent within about five years. His 'The Future is for Everyone' essay adds a looser claim that AI will make curing or preventing all diseases possible 'much sooner' than this century, and an undated line that superintelligence beyond human capacity will be usable 'in the next few years'. Several promising 2026 transcripts (the Jacklyn Dallas '2030' interview, the Connect keynote, the Collison interview) were not read because their PDFs would not open or I ran out of page openings.

reply_text:
I found two dated AI predictions Zuckerberg made in 2026, both in pages I opened and read, and one undated statement about when superintelligence arrives. Neither of the two claims already on file showed up in a page I opened, so neither is marked as a repeat.

**Candidates**
- **Q2 2026 earnings call, 29 July.** The official transcript PDF on Meta's investor site has him saying billions of people will have a personal AI agent within five years. News coverage reported the same point: Meta is "trying to sell investors on his prediction for the future — one where billions of people will have their own personal AI agents in the next five years."
- **"The Future is for Everyone" essay on meta.com.** He writes that he and Priscilla Chan set out to help cure or prevent all diseases this century, and that AI should make this possible "much sooner." The time limit is "this century." This is a fair candidate but not a strong one: he is setting an earlier goal against a new expectation, and "much sooner" names no year. The page itself carries no date. The Marquette "Zuckerberg Files" index lists it on 10 August 2026, and a related Wall Street Journal op-ed ("The AI Future Is for Everyone") on 28 July 2026. I did not open the WSJ version.

**Undated**
- The same essay opens by saying that "in the next few years" people will be able to use superintelligence beyond human capacity. Your rules treat "a few years" as undated, and this one is about when superintelligence arrives, so it goes under undated.

**What I couldn't check**
- **On-file claim of 28 January.** The line "2026 is going to be the year that AI starts to dramatically change the way that we work" (Q4 2025 earnings call) appeared only in search snippets. I did not open a page with it, so I did not list it.
- **On-file claim of 8 September (Sources podcast with Alex Heath).** I opened a third-party transcript on singjupost.com, but the text I received cuts off at about 23 minutes. The part I read has no dated prediction and nothing about AI designing treatments.
- **Two Marquette transcript PDFs failed to open.** One is the Jacklyn Dallas interview of 24 September 2026, titled "Mark Zuckerberg on Muse, 2030, and What Comes Next!". The other is the 8 September Alex Heath interview. The Dallas interview is the most likely place left for a dated claim, but the only versions I saw were machine-translated summaries, so I quoted nothing from it.
- **Not opened at all:** the Meta Connect keynote (23 September), the John Collison interview (12 October), the Q1 2026 call (29 April) and the NBC interview with Joanna Stern.
